description: Hand-curated AUTHORITATIVE per-toll-plaza rates for closed-loop / ticket-system expressways, sourced from operator notifications. Routing APIs (TollGuru, Google, etc.) report only a route TOTAL for these systems and mis-attribute the per-plaza split, so these plazas are corrected here. merge.js applies these as overrides on top of the scaffolded/NHAI base rates. Each plaza records its source and validity window. Only fields explicitly listed under `rates` are overridden; everything else is left untouched. Add only rates you can cite.

code:NETC540003.note: Full-length car toll is Rs.320 one-way, split across two MSRDC plazas: Khalapur Rs.80 + Urse Rs.240. Rates frozen until Apr 2030 per MSRDC (no hike 2023-2030). Per-class (LCV/bus/truck/crane) per-plaza split not yet verified from the MSRDC notification - left untouched until cited.

code:NETC540005.note: Urse plaza car toll Rs.240 (the larger share of the Rs.320 full-length car toll). Frozen until Apr 2030 per MSRDC.
